patches.why: Angle: the hero visitor is solution-aware but not yet committed to a call, so the secondary button gives him the result he wants right away: his own ad. «דמו» is gone. The infinitive matches the current label's register, and «לעסק שלי» echoes the first-person form of «בדוק את העסק שלי». He also sees the action is his. The label is 20 characters with no exclamation mark. «חינם» moved out to save length; the primary button already says it.
